standard_prerequisites.name: The alternating Cech spectral sequence attached to a surjective etale morphism
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, label lemma-alternating-spectral-sequence (invoked at proof line 1345)
standard_prerequisites.use: It computes the cohomology of $X$ from the twisted cohomology of the configuration quotients $U_p$, and requires $f$ to be separated, which holds because $U$ and $X$ are separated.

standard_prerequisites.name: Separatedness of the composite, and the finite flat equivalence for groupoid quotients
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces, label spaces-morphisms-lemma-compose-after-separated (invoked at proof line 1348) and Groupoids, label groupoids-proposition-finite-flat-equivalence (invoked at proof line 1354)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first gives that $f$ is separated; the second identifies $U_p = W_p/S_{p+1}$ as an affine scheme because $W_p$ is affine and the action is free and finite.

standard_prerequisites.name: Vanishing of the higher cohomology of a quasi-coherent module on the affine configuration scheme, and quasi-coherence of the twists
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Cohomology of Schemes, label coherent-lemma-quasi-coherent-affine-cohomology-zero (invoked at proof line 1361) and Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, label lemma-quasi-coherent-twist (invoked at proof line 1363)
standard_prerequisites.use: They make the $E_1$-terms vanish in positive degrees: the twisted sheaves are quasi-coherent, their cohomology on $W_p$ agrees with the cohomology of the corresponding module on the affine scheme, and that vanishes above degree zero.

core_obligations: Apply the alternating Cech spectral sequence; the hypothesis of separatedness of $f$ is met because $U$ and $X$ are separated (proof lines 1344-1348).

Show that $U \times_X \ldots \times_X U$ is affine as a closed subscheme of a product of copies of the affine scheme $U$, hence the configuration scheme $W_p$ is affine, and that $U_p = W_p/S_{p+1}$ is an affine scheme by the groupoid equivalence (proof lines 1349-1354).

Use that the cohomology of a quasi-coherent sheaf on the algebraic space $W_p$ agrees with that of the corresponding sheaf on its underlying affine scheme, and that the twists $\mathcal{F}|_{U_p} \otimes \underline{\mathbf{Z}}(\chi_p)$ are quasi-coherent, to see that the $E_1$-terms vanish for $q > 0$ (proof lines 1355-1369).

Since the fibre bound $d$ gives $W_p = \emptyset$ for $p \geq d$, the remaining $E_1$-terms also vanish there, and the spectral sequence gives $H^q(X, \mathcal{F}) = 0$ for $q \geq d$ (proof lines 1369-1374).
proof_roadmap: The spectral sequence and separatedness (proof lines 1344-1348).
Affineness of the configuration schemes and their quotients (proof lines 1349-1354).
Vanishing of the $E_1$-terms in positive degrees (proof lines 1355-1369).
The range $p \geq d$ and the conclusion (proof lines 1369-1374).
difficulty_reason: The proposition bounds the cohomological dimension of a quasi-coherent sheaf on a quasi-compact separated algebraic space by the number of sheets of an affine etale cover (statement lines 1332-1341). The proof feeds the cover into the alternating Cech spectral sequence, shows that the configuration schemes and their quotients are affine so that their positive cohomology vanishes even after twisting by the quasi-coherent sign sheaves, and finishes because the configuration scheme is empty beyond the fibre bound. The affineness of the configuration quotients is the substance, so the claim is H2.
